properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek is a transitive dependency of the pinned solana-program/solana-sdk 1.16.17 stack (Solana's Ed25519 signature implementation for transaction signing/verification). No direct application call site in evm_loader sources — the Solana runtime exercises it — but the crate ships in the built program/CLI/API binaries. Quantum-unsafe (Shor); deadline-class risk, not harvest-class. Changeable only with the Solana stack upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Pure-Python ECDSA package pinned for the test suite; it is the fallback signing backend of eth-keys/eth-account (web3.py stack), used to sign secp256k1 Ethereum transactions in fixtures (tests/eth_tx_utils.py:177 w3.eth.account.sign_transaction; eth_keys.PrivateKey derivations across test files). The object's canonical 'ECDSA-P256' label is inaccurate for this context — the curve in Ethereum tooling is secp256k1. Quantum-unsafe signature; test scope only. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek is a transitive dependency of the solana-program 1.16.17 stack (Ed25519/Pedersen arithmetic backend). No direct application call site was found in evm_loader sources; the crate ships in the built binaries. X25519-class key agreement is retroactively breakable (harvest-now-decrypt-later) if ever used for transport — here it backs Solana's signature machinery. Changeable only via the Solana stack.
